title: Supplies that cannot bring you peace

captions.physics: Providing for everyday needs at home

meaning: Keeping supplies stops offering reassurance when each purchase only briefly quietens a fear of future shortage.
text: Home may seem more dependable when essentials are available and small needs have been anticipated. The Empress in the physical position of Muladhara expresses care through providing for daily life. The Devil in energy tests your footing through attachment to supplies: you want to retain and increase tangible evidence of security. The Moon in emotions brings uncertainty from which pictures of possible shortage can easily grow. A full cupboard does not necessarily reassure you for long, because anxious imagination finds another reason to wonder whether you have prepared enough for ordinary life.

For example, you buy several more packets of a favourite food although there are already some at home. You feel calmer briefly, then wonder whether you should have bought something else as well. **A supply answers a specific need, rather than every worrying possibility.** Plenty of sincere care can remain between you while bags occupy increasing space. What you actually use now helps reveal a real household need more clearly than each imagined lack.

The vulnerability is turning doubt into another reason to buy and keep. A suggestion to clear a shelf then feels like abandoning safety, and discussing quantities quickly becomes tense. You are trying to protect your shared home, yet it grows more crowded and less reassuring. Support becomes tangible when preparedness can be measured against an understandable need, without asking objects to guarantee protection from everything imagination can produce.
